analysis_methods:
analysis_id: AN01
metric: reported mean lumen diameter
description: Otsu global threshold then Amira 5.3 Autoskeleton; segments have length, volume and mean radius. Six 5-µm segment-length bins span 0–30 µm; mode per bin then average modes forms stack metric.
unit_as_reported: µm
statistical_unit: stack-derived metric; animals/stack dependence not specified
source_locators: 
  [1] S1:ME10
boundary: Source alternates radius/diameter wording without an explicit ×2 step. Preserve published designation; do not silently correct or infer true lumen caliber.

Application.Text20:
analysis_methods:
analysis_id: AN02
metric: capillary density
description: Methods defines total vasculature surface divided by analyzed stack volume; abstract calls it linear density.
unit_as_reported: Fig1/2/4: 10^3 mm^-2
statistical_unit: stack-derived metric; animal n unreported
source_locators: 
  [1] S1:AB01
  [2] S1:ME10
  [3] F1:image
  [4] F2:image
  [5] F4:image
boundary: Surface/volume has dimension L^-1, conflicting with plotted L^-2. Do not silently replace surface with length or pool numerically with standardized density datasets.

Application.Text21:
analysis_methods:
analysis_id: AN03
metric: vascular angular dispersion and myocardial disarray
description: Structure tensor analysis yields local orientation vectors; Methods local direction blocks about 60 µm (S2:56 µm). Local disarray computed in 120-µm portions as 1 minus magnitude of average unit vector, then averaged over full volume. Supplementary S2 specifies separate processing of vessel-lumen and membrane channels, application of the structure tensor directly to grey levels, and use of the eigenvector associated with the smallest eigenvalue to estimate local structure orientation.
unit_as_reported: % in plots
statistical_unit: local orientation -> volume-level aggregate; animal-level analysis not demonstrated
source_locators: 
  [1] S1:ME11
  [2] S2:p2
boundary: Direction overlay colors do not indicate distinct biological labels. Approximate 60 versus56 µm is retained as source-specific precision.

source_locators: 
  [1] S1:ME12
boundary: Optical SHG positive voxel fraction is not biochemical collagen mass or all collagen concentration.
